fusions.name: Circling Bite
fusions.desc: Bites a target at or below 30% health for 18 damage, consuming every affliction on it for 1.6 times their remaining damage, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Scent Run
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 6 tiles at the target and bites for 12 damage, up to 1.3 times that at maximum range, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent Taken
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Fed by the Kill
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 8 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
